headline: Prediction: Up 50% YTD, Cisco Will End The Year at This Price
summary: Cisco has quietly transformed from a slow-growth networking dinosaur into one of 2026's biggest mega-cap winners, but the real question is whether the catalyst behind this rally signals a durable shift or a setup ripe for disappointment.
